reviews.text:
New Favorite Notetaking App. Some months ago I gave this app a try using their free trial, but ultimately set it back down since it was missing some features that were a must for me. I picked it back up recently, and I’m glad I did, because they’ve added in some of those things I was missing (a shapes tool and snap alignment). There’s still some development to be done but this app checks all the boxes for me. The included templates are awesome, page customization is easy and done well, you can make (unlimited?) custom color palettes, there’s a huge array of built in stickers and other assets, a good layering system, and several other things I have been dreaming about in an app like this.

There are a couple bugs that are rather annoying, specifically one where the undo button results in what seems to be a random erasure of large blocks of content that cannot be recovered. I avoid running into this just by using the eraser instead, which can be a bit tedious.

Some other features I would like to see in the future are the ability to switch between the eraser and my last used tool by via the button on my Apple Pencil. An eraser feature that erases an entire line vs the standard precision area. A better curved line tool that lets me drag points of a curve around to get the right shape. But mostly it’s just quality of life stuff at this point.

Happy to support this team and I hope they keep doing what they’re doing. I like that they seem to be focused on adding more actual features and improving user experience rather than pouring resources into incorporating AI into their product (which is not something I have ever desired in a program like this).

I LOVE THIS APP!!!. Okay, first things first, I immediately did the free trial for the yearly subscription, and I seriously think I’m just going to pay for it anyway. So, with that in mind, let me tell you why I love this app so much already!

⭐️ Aesthetics - The stickers!! They’re so cute and just my style! I love how the lined template looks, especially when I’ve written a lot and I zoom out, it’s so satisfying and pretty! Can’t wait to look at all the other stickers they have, and they also have borders and washi tapes (which you can change the opacity of!) and so on in all different kinds of collections! I love that you can also write over them with your pen tool!

⭐️ Tools - I can zoom in and out, undo, tap my apple pencil to switch from my pen to eraser- and there’s so much more! I love being able to change which utensils I use and the sizing+opacity of them. You can even create your own color palettes for so much creativity allowance! I feel so free to unleash my creations and imagination on the pages, it feels like I’m writing in my physical journal! You can also select blocks of text and resize as well as move it wherever you want!

⭐️ Cost - For a journaling app that has so many options and convenient ways for you to write down whatever you can think of… $34.99 a YEAR is crazy good in my opinion, especially because the monthly subscription is $8.99 which would add up $107.88 yearly, whereas $34.99 is $2.91 a month! Insane.

⭐️ PHOTOS - You can add your own images onto the pages! You can crop, resize, rotate, and draw over your photos!!! I LOVE that.

⭐️ Convenience and Inspiration - Whenever I’m too lazy to get up and set up my desk for a journaling session, I can just grab my iPad and start right away! Super convenient for on-the-go and quick sessions! Or if you just don’t want to get out of bed. It also makes me so excited to start journaling again after a while of inconsistent and nearly nonexistent journaling, it’s really inspired me to begin writing again.

Okay, well, that pretty much sums up what I think about the app, get it or don’t. But I love it.

So, this morning, I downloaded the iPad version… and, although I had already accepted a trial, had to go through the series of questions (you CAN answer these on an iPad, developers), then there was no option to sign in and no acknowledgement by the app that I was already using a trial version. And, when I tried to accept a NEW TRIAL that I would have had to cancel, it told me that there was another user with my Apple ID. So, I couldn’t log in, and I couldn’t accept a new trial. I have found a work around, I believe, but the developers need to simplify onboarding, DEBUG IT, and DEBUG/improve app trial, subscription, and synch issues between Apple devices. Also, BTW, the Mac version isn’t great or intuitive.

That said, this APP is AMAZING when you figure out its less than intuitive interface, and it meets SO many different needs. It is an app that I know I will use everyday to journal AND as a planner. I have not checked to see if if can record and transcribe audio, but it should, and I hope it does.

reviews.text: Editing Problems. Basically this service is another app trying to sell you an extremely discounted “weekly” fee that you have to pay an entire year for otherwise they charge you like 5x the price per WEEK! Anyways so I thought it might be worth it but I’m not going to lie, the templates they give you act like a Canva preset. Every time you click, even when you lock the layer, it makes you select the entire preset notes page as an image. On top of that, there’s no way to edit the text in the preset, so if everything really works for you but you want to get rid of the “5 star rating” they put at the bottom with no way to actually fill the stars in, you can’t. You can’t italicize your own text and use the fill tool to cover over the template either because those options don’t exist. This app is only good if you really like the templates and don’t mind it feeling like a google doc with an image pasted into it. Honestly, they should have a free version - but at least they had the one week free so I could cancel it right away.
